lyrics:
[Intro: eerie wordless choir pad, slow heavy kick]

[Chorus: female voice, sung, calm and sure]
Late, but I'm coming
You can start, I'll catch you up
Late, but I'm coming
Twenty years is long enough
Save a seat or don't, I'll stand
Late, but I'm coming

[Verse 1: female rap, measured]
Forty-one, front row, with a pen and a doubt
Kid beside me's younger than the car I got out
Raised three, buried one, worked a register and nights
Put everybody first and called it doing right
Dean said, "Any questions?" Yeah. Where've I been?
Holding up a ceiling so my kids could get in
Now the last one's got her own key and her own rent
And I got a syllabus and no time left to vent

[Chorus: female voice, sung, calm and sure]
Late, but I'm coming
You can start, I'll catch you up
Late, but I'm coming
Twenty years is long enough
Save a seat or don't, I'll stand
Late, but I'm coming

[Verse 2: male rap, her son, proud]
That's my mother with the highlighter, look
She used to read to me from library books
Fell asleep mid-sentence in her uniform
Woke up, clocked in, kept us fed and warm
I got my degree, she clapped until she cried
Now I'm in the bleachers on the other side
Quiz on Friday. She's got flash cards on the fridge.
Tell the honor roll to make a little room. She's rich.

[Bridge: choir pad swells, female voice spoken]
Roll call. Say my name.
Here.

[Final Chorus: female voice, harmonies stacked]
Late, but I'm coming
You can start, I'll catch you up
Late, but I'm coming
Twenty years is long enough
Save a seat or don't, I'll stand
Late, and I'm here

[Outro: choir pad, a pen clicking, a page turned]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 82 BPM, 4/4, D minor. Slow, heavy and haunting, with a great deal of space.

VOICE: A woman sings the hook in a rich, steady alto and raps verse 1 in a measured, unhurried flow. A younger man raps verse 2 with warmth and pride. Her stacked harmonies fill the last chorus.

INSTRUMENTS: A floating, wordless choir pad with long reverb, a slow, heavy kick and a snapping snare, a deep, simple bass line, a muted guitar pluck, a low string drone, a few piano notes.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, choir pad and kick. 0:16 Chorus 1. 0:44 Verse 1. 1:30 Chorus 2. 1:58 Verse 2. 2:44 Bridge. 2:58 Final chorus. 3:28 Outro, pad, a pen and a page, ends 3:56.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-1990s East Coast: dark, spacious and bass-heavy, drums dry, the choir pad far away like fog.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The single spoken 'Here.' at 2:54.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is young people announcing they are coming for the crown. This is a woman of forty-one announcing she is coming for a chair in a classroom, which takes more nerve.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Nervous, resolved, celebrated, present.
